source: Workflow Taxonomy and Use-Case Matrix - Revised Workflow Lanes.xlsx
formula: Priority Score = (0.35 * Value + 0.25 * Readiness + 0.20 * (6 - Complexity) + 0.20 * (6 - Risk)) * 20

workflows.outcome: Increase content output without adding headcount
workflows.pain: Long-form content is underused; owners lack time to turn source material into campaigns
workflows.friction: Manual rewriting across email, social, web, and sales collateral
workflows.useCases: Turn webinars, blogs, founder notes, podcasts, and customer stories into social posts, email copy, blog snippets, FAQs, and short-form video scripts
workflows.baseline: Shared docs, website CMS, email platform, social scheduler
workflows.kpis: Content output volume; time to publish; campaign cadence; engagement rate
workflows.notes: Strong first-cohort quick win
workflows.guardrails: Human review for brand voice, claims, and accuracy

workflows.outcome: Improve campaign consistency and send cadence
workflows.pain: Newsletters, nurture emails, and follow-ups are inconsistent or delayed
workflows.friction: Repeated manual drafting and formatting across campaign types
workflows.useCases: Draft newsletters, promotional emails, nurture sequences, event follow-ups, reactivation emails, and segmented variants
workflows.baseline: Email platform, CRM, shared docs, customer list
workflows.kpis: Send frequency; open rate; click rate; response rate; time saved
workflows.notes: Strong first-cohort fit if list hygiene exists
workflows.guardrails: Human approval before send; no unsupported claims

workflows.outcome: Reduce repetitive content production work
workflows.pain: Owners or small teams struggle to maintain regular posting
workflows.friction: Manual caption writing, calendar planning, and channel-specific adaptation
workflows.useCases: Generate captions, post calendars, creative briefs, platform-specific variants, hashtag sets, and response drafts
workflows.baseline: Social platforms, Canva, shared docs, content calendar
workflows.kpis: Posting cadence; time saved; engagement rate; content backlog reduced
workflows.notes: Good low-risk starter workflow
workflows.guardrails: Review brand tone and sensitive responses

workflows.outcome: Improve targeting and campaign planning discipline
workflows.pain: Campaign ideas are ad hoc; audiences and messages are not clearly segmented
workflows.friction: Planning lives in founder memory, spreadsheets, or scattered notes
workflows.useCases: Build campaign briefs, audience-message matrices, channel plans, campaign timelines, and test plans
workflows.baseline: CRM, email tool, spreadsheet, shared docs
workflows.kpis: Campaign launch speed; segment coverage; qualified lead volume; test velocity
workflows.notes: Best where basic customer list hygiene exists
workflows.guardrails: Review segmentation logic and customer data use

workflows.outcome: Help customers understand products, services, and next steps
workflows.pain: Teams answer recurring education questions manually
workflows.friction: Repeated explanation work across onboarding, support, and sales
workflows.useCases: Create onboarding guides, how-to content, explainer emails, service FAQs, and educational mini-guides
workflows.baseline: Website CMS, shared docs, support docs, email platform
workflows.kpis: FAQ deflection; onboarding time; support questions; customer satisfaction
workflows.notes: Good fit for services, ecommerce, education, and coaching
workflows.guardrails: Review technical accuracy and customer promises

workflows.outcome: Improve clarity and conversion on web/product pages
workflows.pain: Pages are stale, inconsistent, or too time-consuming to update
workflows.friction: Manual copy updates across product, service, and landing pages
workflows.useCases: Draft landing pages, ecommerce product descriptions, service descriptions, local SEO pages, and comparison pages
workflows.baseline: Website CMS, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, shared docs
workflows.kpis: Page update cycle time; conversion rate; search visibility; content completeness
workflows.notes: Strong stack-native fit for ecommerce and services
workflows.guardrails: Review claims, pricing, legal/compliance language

workflows.outcome: Turn proof points into usable sales and marketing assets
workflows.pain: Customer stories exist but are not packaged for sales or marketing
workflows.friction: Manual interview synthesis and copy drafting
workflows.useCases: Convert customer feedback or interviews into case study drafts, testimonial snippets, proof points, and sales enablement copy
workflows.baseline: CRM, review platforms, interview notes, shared docs
workflows.kpis: Case study cycle time; proof assets created; sales usage; conversion support
workflows.notes: Good if consent and source material are clear
workflows.guardrails: Confirm customer permission and factual accuracy

workflows.outcome: Create consistent brand language across channels
workflows.pain: Content varies by writer; brand voice is informal or undocumented
workflows.friction: No reusable voice guide, approved claims list, or review criteria
workflows.useCases: Create a reusable brand voice guide, prompt library, approved claims list, and content review checklist
workflows.baseline: Existing content library, shared docs, website, sales materials
workflows.kpis: Consistency score; review time; rewrite cycles; approved prompt reuse
workflows.notes: Useful foundation for content-heavy businesses
workflows.guidance: Tier 1 or Tier 2 with SME review
workflows.guardrails: Maintain approved claims and final human review

workflows.outcome: Convert marketing activity into next-step decisions
workflows.pain: Campaign data exists but is not reviewed consistently
workflows.friction: Metrics live across tools and are interpreted inconsistently
workflows.useCases: Summarize campaign results, extract learnings, identify best-performing messages, and draft next-test recommendations
workflows.baseline: Email platform, web analytics, Shopify, CRM, spreadsheet
workflows.kpis: Report cycle time; next tests identified; decision speed; campaign ROI
workflows.notes: Bridge between marketing and data/insights lane
workflows.guardrails: Use source data references; avoid unsupported causality claims

workflows.outcome: Support campaign planning with faster external research
workflows.pain: Owners lack time to monitor competitors, reviews, and market trends
workflows.friction: Research is fragmented and inconsistent
workflows.useCases: Summarize competitor messaging, pricing claims, customer reviews, and market signals for campaign planning
workflows.baseline: Web research, review platforms, CRM notes, shared docs
workflows.kpis: Research time saved; insight quality; campaign inputs created
workflows.notes: Useful but less direct ROI than production workflows
workflows.guardrails: Cite sources; review for hallucinations and outdated information

workflows.outcome: Improve conversion and reduce dropped leads
workflows.pain: Leads are not followed up quickly or consistently
workflows.friction: Manual email/SMS follow-up with inconsistent cadence
workflows.useCases: Draft first-response emails, SMS follow-ups, missed-call replies, quote follow-ups, and reactivation messages
workflows.baseline: CRM or spreadsheet, email, SMS tool, website forms
workflows.kpis: Lead response time; meeting-booked rate; conversion rate; follow-up completion
workflows.notes: One of the strongest first-cohort defaults
workflows.guardrails: Human approval before send; avoid pricing or service promises without review

workflows.outcome: Create cleaner lead briefs and faster triage
workflows.pain: Inquiry details arrive across forms, calls, emails, and chats
workflows.friction: Manual review and retyping of scattered lead information
workflows.useCases: Summarize intake forms, inquiries, voicemails, chat transcripts, and call notes into lead briefs
workflows.baseline: Website forms, inbox, CRM, call notes, chat logs
workflows.kpis: Triage time; lead completeness; follow-up quality; handoff speed
workflows.notes: Good if source inputs are accessible
workflows.guardrails: Remove sensitive details not needed for the next step

workflows.outcome: Improve pipeline hygiene and follow-up discipline
workflows.pain: Notes are incomplete; tasks and context fall through the cracks
workflows.friction: Information captured after meetings is fragmented or skipped
workflows.useCases: Convert meeting notes into CRM updates, next steps, contact summaries, deal notes, and follow-up tasks
workflows.baseline: CRM, calendar, meeting transcripts, notes
workflows.kpis: CRM completeness; admin time saved; task completion; follow-up SLA
workflows.notes: Practical and champion-friendly
workflows.guardrails: Review summaries before CRM entry if customer-sensitive

workflows.outcome: Shorten sales cycle and improve consistency
workflows.pain: Proposals and estimates are time-consuming and inconsistent
workflows.friction: Manual copy/paste and rework across similar requests
workflows.useCases: Draft proposals, scopes of work, project summaries, pricing narratives, and client-specific recommendations
workflows.baseline: Docs, proposal templates, CRM, spreadsheet, estimate tool
workflows.kpis: Turnaround time; proposal volume; win rate; revision cycles
workflows.notes: High value if templates and examples already exist
workflows.guardrails: Final human review for scope, price, exclusions, and commitments

workflows.outcome: Improve sales conversations and qualification
workflows.pain: Teams enter calls without consistent prep or question structure
workflows.friction: Manual account research and scattered CRM context
workflows.useCases: Generate account briefs, suggested questions, known pain points, and meeting prep based on CRM/history
workflows.baseline: CRM, website, notes, LinkedIn, calendar
workflows.kpis: Prep time saved; qualification quality; next-step conversion
workflows.notes: Useful support workflow for advisory and B2B services
workflows.guidance: Tier 1 or Tier 2 with SME review
workflows.guardrails: Source-check research and avoid assumptions about prospect needs

workflows.outcome: Improve consistency in sales responses
workflows.pain: Common objections are handled unevenly by different team members
workflows.friction: Responses are improvised and not captured as reusable assets
workflows.useCases: Create response snippets for objections around price, timing, scope, implementation, or comparison shopping
workflows.baseline: Sales notes, CRM, proposal templates, shared docs
workflows.kpis: Response quality; sales cycle time; objection-to-next-step rate
workflows.notes: Good when reviewed and paired with approved messaging
workflows.guardrails: Review tone and avoid unsupported promises

workflows.workflow: Customer response drafting and FAQ support
workflows.outcome: Improve response speed without fully automating service
workflows.pain: Teams answer the same questions repeatedly; quality and tone vary
workflows.friction: Customer replies are manual and inconsistent
workflows.useCases: Draft responses to common service questions, support inquiries, status updates, and post-purchase questions
workflows.baseline: Inbox, help desk, docs, CRM, Shopify
workflows.kpis: Response time; first-response SLA; CSAT; support backlog
workflows.notes: Keep human approval in place; avoid fully autonomous bots by default
workflows.guardrails: Human approval for customer-facing responses

workflows.outcome: Increase retention and expansion follow-up
workflows.pain: Renewals and expansion opportunities are missed or inconsistent
workflows.friction: Manual account review and outreach drafting
workflows.useCases: Draft renewal reminders, service expansion emails, cross-sell language, and check-in sequences
workflows.baseline: CRM, billing/subscription tool, email platform
workflows.kpis: Renewal rate; upsell pipeline; outreach completion; churn reduction
workflows.notes: Good when customer history is accessible and reviewed
workflows.guidance: Tier 1 or Tier 2 with SME review
workflows.guardrails: Review eligibility, pricing, and customer context

workflows.outcome: Reduce dropped context after a sale closes
workflows.pain: Delivery teams lack clear context from sales conversations
workflows.friction: Manual handoff summaries and inconsistent kickoff notes
workflows.useCases: Convert closed-won notes into onboarding summaries, internal handoff briefs, kickoff agendas, and delivery checklists
workflows.baseline: CRM, docs, project management tool, email
workflows.kpis: Handoff completeness; kickoff speed; rework reduction; client satisfaction
workflows.notes: Strong workflow for service businesses
workflows.guardrails: Review for scope accuracy and sensitive customer details

workflows.outcome: Respond consistently to public reviews and customer feedback
workflows.pain: Reviews are ignored or handled inconsistently
workflows.friction: Manual public response drafting with reputation risk
workflows.useCases: Draft review responses, categorize sentiment, identify escalation cases, and summarize recurring themes
workflows.baseline: Google Business Profile, review platforms, CRM, inbox
workflows.kpis: Response time; review coverage; sentiment themes; escalation resolution
workflows.notes: Useful but requires brand/reputation review
workflows.guardrails: Human review before public posting

workflows.outcome: Reduce tribal knowledge and improve repeatability
workflows.pain: Processes live in people’s heads; onboarding is inconsistent
workflows.friction: Instructions are scattered or undocumented
workflows.useCases: Turn process notes, Loom videos, meeting transcripts, or staff instructions into step-by-step SOPs
workflows.baseline: Docs, shared drive, notes, videos, messaging threads
workflows.kpis: Documentation coverage; onboarding time; error reduction; owner dependency
workflows.notes: Low-risk, high-utility starter workflow
workflows.guardrails: Review with actual process owner before publishing

workflows.outcome: Improve internal access to repeatable information
workflows.pain: Employees ask the same internal questions repeatedly
workflows.friction: Knowledge lives across docs, chats, emails, and owner memory
workflows.useCases: Create team FAQs, knowledge base articles, role guides, checklists, and how-to documents
workflows.baseline: Shared drive, SharePoint, Drive, Notion, messaging tools
workflows.kpis: Search time reduced; repeated questions reduced; doc usage
workflows.notes: Strong internal implementation use case
workflows.guardrails: Keep source-of-truth owner and update cadence

workflows.outcome: Standardize employee, client, or vendor onboarding
workflows.pain: Onboarding varies by person and misses steps
workflows.friction: Manual checklist creation and inconsistent handoffs
workflows.useCases: Build employee onboarding, client onboarding, vendor onboarding, and project kickoff checklists
workflows.baseline: Docs, project management tool, HR/client onboarding materials
workflows.kpis: Onboarding time; missed steps; completion rate; new-hire/client satisfaction
workflows.notes: Good fit across many verticals
workflows.guardrails: Review legal, HR, and customer-specific requirements

workflows.outcome: Convert conversations into accountable next steps
workflows.pain: Meetings create notes but not clear ownership or follow-through
workflows.friction: Manual summarization and task creation after meetings
workflows.useCases: Convert meeting transcripts into summaries, decisions, owners, deadlines, and follow-up tasks
workflows.baseline: Calendar, meeting transcripts, docs, project management tool
workflows.kpis: Task completion; admin time saved; decision capture; follow-up speed
workflows.notes: Strong productivity workflow with low technical burden
workflows.guardrails: Review decisions and assigned owners before sharing

workflows.outcome: Free owner/admin time from repeated status work
workflows.pain: Weekly updates and status reports consume time
workflows.friction: Repeating low-leverage documentation tasks
workflows.useCases: Summarize weekly operations updates, inbox themes, project status notes, or client activity
workflows.baseline: Email, docs, project management tool, shared drive
workflows.kpis: Admin time saved; report cycle time; completion rate
workflows.notes: Good supporting use case but less strategic than revenue workflows
workflows.guardrails: Review for accuracy and omitted context

workflows.outcome: Reduce coordination burden and missed prep
workflows.pain: Scheduling and reminder messages are repetitive
workflows.friction: Manual back-and-forth communication and prep instructions
workflows.useCases: Draft scheduling emails, appointment confirmations, prep instructions, and reminder templates
workflows.baseline: Calendar, email, scheduling tool, CRM
workflows.kpis: Scheduling cycle time; no-show rate; admin time saved
workflows.notes: Useful but often a supporting workflow
workflows.guardrails: Human review before calendar commitments if automated

workflows.outcome: Reduce outstanding receivables and admin burden
workflows.pain: Invoices go out late or follow-up is inconsistent
workflows.friction: Manual reminders and inconsistent collections discipline
workflows.useCases: Draft payment reminders, past-due follow-ups, installment notices, and collections escalation language
workflows.baseline: QuickBooks, accounting system, spreadsheet, email
workflows.kpis: Days sales outstanding; overdue invoice count; follow-up completion; cash collected
workflows.notes: Good fit when accounting records are clean
workflows.guidance: Tier 1 or Tier 2 with SME review
workflows.guardrails: Review tone, customer history, and payment facts

workflows.outcome: Reduce manual finance prep and improve visibility
workflows.pain: Owners spend time organizing receipts, transactions, and month-end notes
workflows.friction: Repetitive categorization and cleanup work
workflows.useCases: Generate categorization suggestions, receipt summaries, missing-document lists, transaction explanations, and accountant prep packets
workflows.baseline: QuickBooks, Xero, bank export, receipt capture, spreadsheet
workflows.kpis: Close time; reconciliation time; missing docs; reporting turnaround
workflows.notes: Use only with human review and data boundaries
workflows.guardrails: Do not automate accounting judgment; accountant/bookkeeper review required

workflows.outcome: Improve consistency in vendor follow-up and issue handling
workflows.pain: Vendor updates are informal and scattered
workflows.friction: Manual follow-up and issue summarization
workflows.useCases: Draft vendor follow-ups, order status requests, issue summaries, and procurement/admin emails
workflows.baseline: Email, procurement docs, inventory/order systems
workflows.kpis: Response time; issue closure; admin time saved
workflows.notes: Good supporting workflow for operations-heavy businesses
workflows.guardrails: Review commitments, quantities, and payment terms

workflows.outcome: Improve consistency before work leaves the business
workflows.pain: Review criteria are informal or vary by person
workflows.friction: Manual QA and subjective approval steps
workflows.useCases: Build review checklists for proposals, content, client deliverables, invoices, onboarding, or service delivery
workflows.baseline: Docs, templates, project management tool, shared drive
workflows.kpis: Error reduction; review time; revision cycles; approval consistency
workflows.notes: Strong complement to every workflow lane
workflows.guardrails: Assign reviewer and keep checklist updated

workflows.outcome: Turn SOPs into practical enablement assets
workflows.pain: Training is informal and dependent on owners or senior staff
workflows.friction: Manual conversion of processes into learning materials
workflows.useCases: Convert SOPs into training guides, quick-reference sheets, role instructions, and quiz/check questions
workflows.baseline: SOPs, docs, LMS, shared drive
workflows.kpis: Training time; completion rate; support questions; process adherence
workflows.notes: Useful for sustainment after the pilot
workflows.guardrails: Review with process owner and update as workflow changes

workflows.outcome: Improve findability and source-of-truth discipline
workflows.pain: Files are hard to locate; duplicate versions create confusion
workflows.friction: Information architecture is informal or inconsistent
workflows.useCases: Create naming conventions, folder structures, document inventories, and source-of-truth maps
workflows.baseline: Google Drive, SharePoint, Dropbox, Notion
workflows.kpis: Search time; duplicate files reduced; source-of-truth adoption
workflows.notes: Useful foundation before knowledge-heavy AI workflows
workflows.guidance: Tier 1 or Tier 2 with SME review
workflows.guardrails: Assign ownership and update cadence

workflows.outcome: Help owners act on business data faster
workflows.pain: Reports exist but are underused or too hard to interpret
workflows.friction: Data is spread across dashboards, exports, and spreadsheets
workflows.useCases: Turn dashboard exports or spreadsheets into plain-English weekly performance summaries
workflows.baseline: Spreadsheet, BI dashboard, accounting export, CRM export
workflows.kpis: Reporting frequency; decision cycle time; action completion
workflows.notes: Good bridge case when data is already accessible
workflows.guardrails: Reference source data and avoid unsupported recommendations

workflows.outcome: Explain trends, anomalies, and likely drivers
workflows.pain: Owners see metrics but lack time or confidence to interpret them
workflows.friction: Manual review of charts and exports without consistent commentary
workflows.useCases: Explain trends, anomalies, changes, and likely drivers from sales, marketing, finance, or ops dashboards
workflows.baseline: CRM dashboard, Shopify analytics, QuickBooks, spreadsheet, BI tool
workflows.kpis: Insight cycle time; actions identified; reporting adoption
workflows.notes: Selective if data source is clear and trusted
workflows.guardrails: Keep human decision-maker; require source references

workflows.outcome: Improve marketing decisions from actual results
workflows.pain: Campaign results are not converted into next actions
workflows.friction: Metrics are reviewed inconsistently across channels
workflows.useCases: Summarize results, compare channels, identify best segments, and suggest next tests
workflows.baseline: Email platform, CRM, web analytics, Shopify, spreadsheet
workflows.kpis: Next tests created; campaign ROI; decision speed; learning velocity
workflows.notes: Strong fit for data-ready marketing teams
workflows.guardrails: Avoid overclaiming causality from weak data

workflows.outcome: Find patterns in reviews, surveys, and support messages
workflows.pain: Feedback exists but is not synthesized into action
workflows.friction: Qualitative data is scattered across reviews, tickets, calls, and surveys
workflows.useCases: Analyze reviews, surveys, support tickets, call notes, or emails to identify recurring themes and pain points
workflows.baseline: Review platforms, help desk, CRM, surveys, inbox
workflows.kpis: Themes identified; support/product actions; response time; CSAT movement
workflows.notes: Good fit if data can be de-identified or reviewed safely
workflows.guidance: Tier 1 or Tier 2 with SME review
workflows.guardrails: De-identify sensitive customer data where possible

workflows.outcome: Improve visibility into pipeline health and follow-up gaps
workflows.pain: Stalled deals and follow-up gaps are hard to spot
workflows.friction: CRM data exists but is not reviewed consistently
workflows.useCases: Summarize pipeline movement, stalled deals, lead sources, conversion patterns, and follow-up gaps
workflows.baseline: CRM, spreadsheet, sales dashboard
workflows.kpis: Pipeline hygiene; stalled deal count; follow-up completion; forecast confidence
workflows.notes: Useful where CRM hygiene is strong enough
workflows.guardrails: Do not automate deal decisions; review assumptions

workflows.outcome: Improve financial planning and resilience
workflows.pain: Cash-flow surprises create stress; planning is reactive
workflows.friction: Forecasting is manual or absent
workflows.useCases: Create plain-English summaries of cash-flow scenarios, receivables, payables, and short-term risks
workflows.baseline: QuickBooks, accounting data, spreadsheet, invoicing data
workflows.kpis: Planning cadence; forecast visibility; cash risk flagged; DSO movement
workflows.notes: Valuable but sensitive; selective only
workflows.guardrails: Financial owner/accountant review required

workflows.outcome: Prioritize receivables follow-up and collections work
workflows.pain: Overdue invoices are reviewed inconsistently
workflows.friction: Manual aging review and follow-up prioritization
workflows.useCases: Summarize overdue invoices, customer payment patterns, collection priorities, and follow-up categories
workflows.baseline: QuickBooks, accounting system, spreadsheet
workflows.kpis: DSO; overdue balance; follow-up completion; cash collected
workflows.notes: Selective finance-adjacent insight workflow
workflows.guardrails: Review customer context and financial facts before action

workflows.outcome: Reduce stockouts, overordering, and manual planning
workflows.pain: Inventory decisions rely on intuition; data is fragmented
workflows.friction: Forecasting needs multiple data sources and exception handling
workflows.useCases: Summarize product demand, stockout patterns, seasonal trends, reorder risks, and sales velocity
workflows.baseline: POS, Shopify, inventory tool, spreadsheet
workflows.kpis: Stockout rate; excess inventory; forecast variance; reorder accuracy
workflows.notes: Usually too data-dependent for default first cohort
workflows.guardrails: Human review before purchasing or inventory commitments

workflows.outcome: Support strategy with faster external and internal research
workflows.pain: Owners lack time to synthesize market and customer signals
workflows.friction: Research and customer signals are fragmented
workflows.useCases: Summarize segments, competitor positioning, market signals, and opportunity areas
workflows.baseline: Web research, reviews, CRM notes, survey data
workflows.kpis: Research time saved; decision confidence; opportunity list created
workflows.notes: Useful for planning but not always measurable in 12 weeks
workflows.guardrails: Cite sources and verify claims

workflows.outcome: Improve communication of business performance and decisions
workflows.pain: Updates are inconsistent or take too long to prepare
workflows.friction: Manual synthesis of KPIs, risks, and operating notes
workflows.useCases: Convert KPI data and operating notes into a monthly business update, risks section, and decision list
workflows.baseline: Spreadsheet, CRM, accounting export, project notes
workflows.kpis: Prep time saved; update cadence; decision clarity; advisor engagement
workflows.notes: Good for more mature SMB operators
workflows.guardrails: Review financials, strategy claims, and sensitive details

workflows.outcome: Identify reporting gaps before advanced AI use
workflows.pain: Data is incomplete, duplicated, or inconsistent
workflows.friction: Reporting issues are hidden until analysis fails
workflows.useCases: Identify missing fields, inconsistent tracking, duplicate records, unclear sources of truth, and reporting gaps
workflows.baseline: CRM, spreadsheet, QuickBooks, Shopify, BI tool
workflows.kpis: Data completeness; duplicate reduction; source-of-truth clarity; audit findings resolved
workflows.notes: Important prerequisite for data-heavy workflows
workflows.guardrails: Do not infer missing facts; document data limitations

workflows.outcome: Support planning around capacity and service volume
workflows.pain: Staffing decisions rely on intuition and reactive scheduling
workflows.friction: Workload data is fragmented or informal
workflows.useCases: Summarize workload patterns, service volume, scheduling pressure, and staffing pinch points
workflows.baseline: Scheduling tool, CRM, time tracking, spreadsheet
workflows.kpis: Forecast accuracy; overtime; service backlog; staffing decisions
workflows.notes: Advanced and data-dependent
workflows.guardrails: Human management review; avoid automated employment decisions

workflows.workflow: High-risk financial or regulated decision automation
workflows.outcome: Automate sensitive decisions
workflows.pain: Interest in automating approvals or decisions touching sensitive data
workflows.friction: High exposure with unclear controls or auditability
workflows.useCases: Autonomous credit, payment, legal, hiring, insurance, tax, or regulated decisions
workflows.baseline: Accounting, HR, legal, regulated systems
workflows.kpis: N/A
workflows.notes: Exclude unless a separate governance-heavy program exists
workflows.guardrails: Do not pilot in default cohort

workflows.workflow: Autonomous customer-facing bot with no reviewer
workflows.outcome: Reduce service workload through full automation
workflows.pain: Teams want 24/7 coverage but lack governance and QA
workflows.friction: High autonomy in live customer interactions
workflows.useCases: Full autonomous chat or messaging without approval, escalation, or monitoring
workflows.baseline: Help desk, chatbot platform, website chat
workflows.kpis: N/A
workflows.notes: Too much reputational and quality risk for initial pilot
workflows.guardrails: Human review/escalation required before any customer automation

workflows.outcome: Execute multi-step work without human approval
workflows.pain: Interest in agents that change records, send messages, or trigger transactions independently
workflows.friction: High autonomy across multiple systems with unclear rollback or auditability
workflows.useCases: Agents that update CRM, send emails, create invoices, change inventory, or trigger workflows without approval
workflows.baseline: CRM, email, accounting, ecommerce, automation tools
workflows.kpis: N/A
workflows.notes: Defer until workflow, permissions, logs, and approval gates are mature
workflows.guardrails: Require explicit approval gates, logs, and rollback path

lanes.why: Broad SMB demand signal; strong low-risk content and campaign use cases; clear measurable outputs.
lanes.sme: Growth marketing, lifecycle, ecommerce retention, content systems
lanes.contentFit: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Shopify, HubSpot, Canva

lanes.why: Strong revenue linkage through lead response, proposals, CRM hygiene, and customer communication.
lanes.sme: Revenue ops, sales enablement, customer success, CRM process
lanes.contentFit: Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic, HubSpot, Square, Google

lanes.role: Standing Group C / Tier 1 with finance controls
lanes.why: Strong implementation value through SOPs, documentation, admin summaries, and repeatable internal workflows.
lanes.sme: Business ops, finance ops, SOP/process improvement

lanes.why: Strategically useful, but data quality, source-of-truth clarity, and sensitivity determine fit.
lanes.sme: Business analytics, ops analytics, finance planning, lightweight BI
lanes.contentFit: Google, Microsoft, AWS, Shopify, HubSpot, Intuit

lanes.why: Autonomous or sensitive decisioning creates governance, reputation, compliance, and quality risk beyond first-cohort scope.
